name: vmarkd-vscode-e2e
description: Real-VS-Code webview suite (vscode-test-playwright). Isolated from the root manifest so its beta test-tooling deps (and their dev-only advisories) never reach the shipped extension's audit gate. Three tiers, defined in playwright.config.ts: `test:smoke` (PR gate), `test:fast` (routine local run), `test` (everything — the nightly/tag gate). *spike* specs are excluded by default — run them via test:spikes.
